seo.description: Everything a salon or parlour needs — chairs and facial beds, hair machines, wax and parlour products, skin care, hair colour, makeup, brushes, disposables and jewellery. Gents and ladies parlour products, all brands.

props.heading: Everything your parlour runs on
props.sub: From salon chairs and facial beds to wax, hair colour, skin care, makeup and brushes — one counter for the whole shopping list. Twenty categories, all major brands, open every day 10 AM to 10 PM.

props.label: About Us
props.heading: A supply counter built for working beauticians
props.body:
Indrashobha Cosmetics stocks what a salon or parlour actually gets through in a month — not a curated shelf of a few premium lines, but the full working list. Wax in every flavour and band size, developers in all brands, hair colour from L'Oréal, Matrix, Streax, Yutika, Enega and Bigen, facial kits, skin care, disposables, brushes and the machines to use them with.

We supply both gents and ladies parlour products, and we carry the equipment side too — salon chairs, facial beds, crimpers, dryers, straighteners and tongs, dummy stands for practice, and manicure and pedicure sets.

Retail customers are just as welcome as salon owners. If you are buying skin care, makeup, nail polish or jewellery for yourself, the same counter and the same brands are open to you.

Run by Manisha Choudhari. Open seven days a week, 10 AM to 10 PM.

props.label: What We Stock
props.heading: Popular categories
props.sub: A sample of what is on the shelves. Open any category to choose your brand and place an order.

items.title: Salon Chairs & Facial Beds
items.desc: Styling chairs, shampoo stations and facial beds for new parlour setups and replacements.
items.body:
Furniture for a working parlour — salon styling chairs and facial beds, suitable for a new setup or for replacing a chair that has given up.

We stock more than one build quality, because a chair for a busy chain of appointments is a different purchase from a chair for a home parlour. Come and sit in them if you can; if you cannot, tell us how many hours a day it will be in use and we will point you at the right one.

Delivery can be arranged locally. For a full parlour fit-out, send us your floor plan or just the number of stations and we will quote the lot together — that is usually cheaper than buying piece by piece.

Rate on request, as it depends on model and quantity.

items.title: Hair Machines
items.desc: Crimpers, dryers, straighteners and tongs — professional models for daily salon use.
items.body:
Professional hair machines built for salon duty cycles rather than occasional home use — crimpers, dryers, straighteners and tongs.

The difference between a retail model and a salon model is mostly heat recovery and motor life. A dryer used thirty times a day needs a different motor from one used twice a week, and a straightener used back to back needs plates that come back to temperature quickly. We stock both, and we will tell you honestly which one your workload needs.

Tell us the machine and roughly how many clients a day it will handle, and we will quote what suits. Rate on request.

items.title: Parlour Products & Wax
items.desc: Wax in all flavours and band sizes, wax strips, heaters, containers, waxing oil, eyebrow razors, massage cream, scrub and pack.
items.body:
The waxing and general parlour consumables — the things that run out fastest and are most annoying to be caught short of.

Wax in all flavours and band sizes, wax strips, wax heaters and spare containers, waxing oil, eyebrow razors, massage cream, scrub and pack.

This is the category most worth ordering in bulk. Wax and strips keep well, the per-unit rate drops sharply with quantity, and running out mid-appointment costs more than the storage space. If you tell us roughly how many waxing appointments you do in a month we can suggest a sensible reorder quantity rather than you guessing.

Rate on request — it varies by flavour, band size and quantity.

items.title: Hair Colour
items.desc: L'Oréal, Matrix, Streax, Yutika, Enega Fruit Color and Bigen — full shade ranges.
items.body:
Full shade ranges from the brands salons here actually use — L'Oréal, Matrix, Streax, Yutika, Enega Fruit Color and Bigen.

We keep the common shades in depth rather than one tube of everything, so a mid-appointment top-up is usually possible. If you work in a shade we do not have on the shelf, tell us and we will get it in.

Developers are listed separately and are stocked in all brands. If you are new to a colour line, order the matching developer with it — cross-brand mixing is the most common cause of a result that does not lift the way the chart says.

Rate on request, by brand and shade.

items.title: Skin Care
items.desc: Face wash, toner, scrub, serum, and day and night creams.
items.body:
The full skin care shelf — face wash, toner, scrub, serum, and day and night creams.

Stocked for both sides of the counter: salon-size containers for treatments, and retail packs for clients who want to carry the routine home. Retailing the aftercare is usually the easiest extra margin a parlour can add, and clients tend to prefer buying it from the person who just did their facial.

If you are putting together a retail shelf for the first time, tell us roughly what your clients spend and we will suggest a starting range rather than selling you one of everything.

Rate on request.

items.title: Makeup Material
items.desc: The full makeup counter across all the brands salons and customers ask for.
items.body:
The general makeup counter — lipsticks, eye products, kajal, liners and the rest of the everyday range, across the brands both salons and retail customers ask for.

For face products specifically (foundation, primer, highlighter, strobe and compact), see the Face Makeup listing, which is stocked separately.

Bridal and party makeup artists ordering a working kit rather than single pieces should tell us that when enquiring — we will put the list together and quote it as a set, which usually works out better than item by item.

Rate on request; it depends entirely on brand and pack.

props.blurb: Indrashobha Cosmetics — gents and ladies parlour products, salon equipment, cosmetics and jewellery. All major brands, open every day 10 AM to 10 PM.
props.termsBody:
Product availability, brand and pack size vary with stock. Rates quoted are valid on the day of enquiry and may change with brand pricing.

Bulk and salon rates are offered on qualifying quantities and are confirmed at the counter or in writing before an order is packed.

Cosmetics, skin care and hair products are sold sealed. For hygiene reasons, opened items cannot be returned or exchanged unless the product is faulty or the seal was broken before sale.

Equipment such as chairs, facial beds and hair machines carries the manufacturer's warranty on the manufacturer's terms. Damage caused by misuse, incorrect voltage or unauthorised repair is not covered.

Shade, colour and finish shown in photographs on this website are indicative. Actual product appearance may differ between batches and brands.

We carry kits for the common skin concerns — brightening, de-tan, anti-ageing, oily and acne-prone, and gold and fruit ranges. Tell us which brand you already work with and what your clients ask for most, and we will tell you what we have on the shelf.

items.title: Hair Care
items.desc: Shampoo, conditioner and hair spa products for salon and retail.
items.body:
Shampoo, conditioner and hair spa products, in salon backwash sizes and retail bottles.

We stock the sulphate-free and colour-safe ranges as well as the standard ones — worth stocking if you do a lot of colour work, because washing fresh colour with the wrong shampoo strips it and the client blames the colour.

Backwash-size containers are the cheaper way to buy for salon use. Retail bottles of the same line let clients keep the result going at home, which protects your colour work and adds a little margin.

Rate on request.

items.desc: L'Oréal, Matrix, Streax, Yutika, Enega Fruit Color and Bigen — full shade ranges.

items.title: Nail Polish
items.desc: Full shade ranges in gel and regular finishes, single pieces or by the box.
items.body:
Nail polish in full shade ranges, regular and gel finishes, sold as single pieces or by the box.

By the box is the sensible way for a parlour to buy — shade ranges sell unevenly and having the range on display sells more than having six bottles of the popular colour.

We also carry the supporting products: base coat, top coat, remover and the tools. Ask if you are setting up a nail section from scratch and we will put a starter list together.

Rate on request.

items.title: Moisturizer
items.desc: Face and body moisturisers across brands, in retail and salon pack sizes.
items.body:
Face and body moisturisers across the brands, in retail packs and larger salon containers.

Salon sizes for use during treatments, retail packs for clients to take home. Both sit on the same shelf here, and the salon rate applies to either if you are ordering in quantity.

Seasonal note worth planning for: the heavier winter creams move quickly once the weather turns and are the thing parlours most often run short of. Order those a few weeks earlier than feels necessary.

Rate on request.

items.title: Blades for Salon
items.desc: Salon razor blades and eyebrow razors — sold in boxes for professional use.
items.body:
Salon razor blades and eyebrow razors, sold in boxes for professional use.

Blades are single-use per client — this is not the place to economise, and clients increasingly notice whether a fresh blade is opened in front of them. Buying by the box keeps the per-blade cost low enough that there is no temptation to stretch one.

We keep the sizes that fit the common salon razor handles. If you use a less common handle, bring it in or send a photo and we will match the blade to it.

Rate on request, by box.

items.title: Aftershave
items.desc: Aftershave lotions and balms for gents parlour work.
items.body:
Aftershave lotions and balms for gents parlour work, in salon containers and retail bottles.

Balms suit clients with sensitive skin or anyone getting a close shave regularly; the alcohol lotions are what most gents parlours use as standard. Stocking both is worth the shelf space — the client who reacts to the standard lotion is the one who stops coming without telling you why.

Retail bottles of whatever you use in the chair tend to sell themselves at the counter.

Rate on request.

items.title: Smoothening, Keratin & Spa
items.desc: Smoothening and straightening systems, keratin, hair botox, spa products and hair serum.
items.body:
The chemical treatment range — smoothening and straightening systems, keratin, hair botox, spa products and hair serum.

These are the highest-value services most parlours offer, and the products are correspondingly the most expensive thing on the restocking list, so it is worth buying the full system rather than mixing steps between brands. The aftercare shampoo matters as much as the treatment itself; a keratin job washed with the wrong shampoo will not last, and the client will remember the result rather than their shampoo.

Tell us which system you are trained on and we will quote the complete kit including aftercare.

Rate on request.

items.title: Face Makeup
items.desc: Foundation, primer, highlighter, strobe and compact across all brands.
items.body:
Face base products — foundation, primer, highlighter, strobe and compact, across all the brands.

Stocked in the shade ranges that actually suit Indian skin tones rather than the imported ranges that stop three shades too light. If you do bridal work, the deeper end of the range is the part worth keeping in depth; it is the part most shops run out of.

Makeup artists buying a working kit should ask for it as a kit rather than piece by piece — we will price the list together.

Rate on request.

items.title: Salon Disposables
items.desc: Tissue paper, facial gowns, facial bedsheets and facial aprons — the consumables that run out fastest.
items.body:
The disposables — tissue paper, facial gowns, facial bedsheets and facial aprons.

Unglamorous and the single most common thing to run out of mid-week. They are also the cheapest category to over-order: they do not expire, they stack flat, and the per-unit rate improves noticeably at quantity.

A fresh disposable sheet put on the bed in front of the client does more for how a parlour is judged than most of what is spent on decor.

Order by the carton for the best rate. Rate on request.

items.title: Makeup Brushes
items.desc: Individual brushes and full professional sets, with holders and cleaning products.
items.body:
Individual brushes and complete professional sets, plus holders, rolls and brush cleaning products.

Sets are the cheaper way in and fine for general parlour work. Artists who use one or two brushes constantly are usually better off replacing those individually in a better quality rather than buying another whole set — we sell singles for exactly that reason.

Brush cleaner is worth adding to any brush order. Clean brushes last several times longer, and the cost of the cleaner is a fraction of replacing the set.

Rate on request.

items.title: Manicure & Pedicure
items.desc: Manicure and pedicure tools, kits and consumables for salon treatments.
items.body:
Manicure and pedicure tools, complete kits and the consumables that go with them.

Tools — cutters, pushers, files, buffers — plus the treatment consumables: soaks, scrubs, packs and creams. Available as a complete kit if you are adding mani-pedi to your service list for the first time, or individually to replace what has worn out.

Tools are worth buying once in a decent steel. Cheap cutters blunt within weeks, and a blunt cutter on a client's cuticle is how a parlour gets a bad review.

Rate on request.

items.title: Developers — All Brands
items.desc: Cream developers in every volume and brand, matched to the colour lines we stock.
items.body:
Cream developers in all brands, matched to the colour lines we carry.

Order the developer from the same brand as your colour wherever you can. Cross-brand mixing is the most common reason a colour does not lift the way the shade chart promised, and it is almost always diagnosed as a bad batch of colour when it is really a mismatched developer.

We stock the standard volumes. Tell us the brand and volume you work with and we will confirm what is on the shelf; if you are unsure which volume a particular lift needs, ask at the counter.

Rate on request.

items.title: Dummy Stands
items.desc: Mannequin heads and stands for cutting, colouring and styling practice — for salons and training students.
items.body:
Mannequin heads and stands for cutting, colouring and styling practice.

Used by salons training junior staff and by students working through a beautician course. Available as a head on its own, a head with a clamp stand, or a stand on its own if you already have heads.

Human-hair heads take colour and chemical treatments properly and are what you need for colour practice; synthetic heads are cheaper and fine for cutting and basic styling. Tell us what the practice is for and we will point you at the right one rather than the dearer one.

Rate on request.

items.title: Jewellery
items.desc: Earrings, necklaces, bangles and mangalsutra — imitation jewellery for retail and gifting.
items.body:
Imitation jewellery — earrings, necklaces, bangles and mangalsutra.

Stocked for retail and gifting, and it sits naturally next to a parlour counter: a client who has just had her hair and makeup done for a function is the most likely person in the shop to buy earrings to go with it.

We carry everyday pieces and heavier bridal and festive sets. Bridal sets move hardest in wedding season, so order those ahead rather than in the week they are needed.

Available as single pieces or by the box for resale. Rate on request.

seo.title: About Indrashobha Cosmetics | Salon Supply, Run by Manisha Choudhari
seo.description: Indrashobha Cosmetics supplies gents and ladies parlour products, salon equipment and cosmetics across twenty categories and all major brands. Run by Manisha Choudhari, open seven days a week.

props.heading: About us
props.sub: The supply counter behind a lot of local parlours.

props.label: Our Story
props.heading: Stock the whole list, not the highlights
props.body:
Most beauty shops carry the products that photograph well. A working parlour needs the rest of it too — the wax strips, the developers, the facial aprons, the box of blades, the dummy stand for practice. Indrashobha Cosmetics was built around that full list.

We carry twenty categories. On the equipment side that means salon chairs, facial beds, crimpers, dryers, straighteners, tongs, manicure and pedicure sets and dummy stands. On the consumable side it means wax in every flavour and band size, wax heaters and containers, waxing oil, eyebrow razors, tissue, gowns, bedsheets and aprons. And on the product side, hair colour and developers in all brands, facial kits, skin care, hair care, smoothening and keratin systems, makeup, brushes, nail polish and jewellery.

We sell to both gents and ladies parlours, and to retail customers buying for themselves. There is no separate counter and no minimum — a salon owner restocking for the month and a customer buying one lipstick get the same brands and the same attention.

The shop is run by Manisha Choudhari and is open seven days a week, 10 AM to 10 PM, which is deliberate: most parlour owners can only get out to restock after their own shop closes.

items.name: Manisha Choudhari
items.bio: Runs the shop day to day. Knows which brand of colour matches which developer, what a parlour gets through in a month, and what is worth ordering in bulk — worth asking before you buy.
